description: This file provides specialized implementations of the copysign function for half-precision floating point types (Half and BFloat16). It includes generic template support and specific bitwise operations to handle these types efficiently, including workarounds for compiler issues.

classes.name: Half
classes.description: Class representing half-precision floating point numbers, supporting bit operations and from_bits() method.

classes.name: BFloat16
classes.description: Class representing BFloat16 floating point numbers, supporting bit operations and from_bits() method.

methods.name: auto copysign(const T & a,const U & b)
methods.description: Generic template function that calls std::copysign for any types T and U.

methods.name: c10::BFloat16 copysign(c10::BFloat16 a,c10::BFloat16 b)
methods.description: Specialized overload for c10::Half type to copy the sign bit from one Half to another.

methods.name: c10::Half copysign(c10::Half a,c10::Half b)
methods.description: Specialized overload for c10::BFloat16 type to copy the sign bit from one BFloat16 to another.
